User.title: User Profile
User.description: Represents a Bharat Connect registered user profile

uid.description: The unique identifier of the user (from Firebase Authentication)

displayName.description: The name selected by the user

phoneNumber.description: The Indian phone number of the user with regional prefix

email.description: Optional email address associated with the account

avatarUrl.description: URL of the profile photo uploaded by the user

statusMessage.description: Brief bio status, e.g. 'Connecting Bharat 🇮🇳' or 'At the Gym'

primaryLanguage.description: The user's preferred language for real-time AI subtitle translation

onlineStatus.description: Real-time presence state of the user

lastSeen.description: Timestamp of the user's last interaction

ChatRoom.title: Chat Room
ChatRoom.description: Either a one-to-one conversational bridge or a multi-party group

id.description: Unique identifier of the chat room

name.description: Name of the group (if group), or empty for one-to-one chats

members.description: List of user UIDs participating in this room

lastMessageText.description: Preview of the most recent message posted

Message.title: Chat Message
Message.description: A single text or media message sent within a specific ChatRoom

senderId.description: UID of the user who sent the message

senderName.description: Display name of the sender cache

text.description: Actual raw content of the message

fileUrl.description: Optional URL pointing to any uploaded media files

reactions.description: Key-value map of emoji reactions, e.g. {'👍': ['uid1', 'uid2']}

seenBy.description: List of user UIDs who have read this message

CallHistory.title: Call History
CallHistory.description: A record of an audio or video calling session

id.description: Unique identifier of the call session

hostId.description: UID of the caller who initiated the dial sequence

type.description: The media type of the call

isGroup.description: True if this was a group room lobby meeting

durationSeconds.description: Length of call session in seconds

chats/{chatId}.description: Top-level index of chat communication channels

chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Nested collection of individual exchange messages

calls/{callId}.description: Log of completed and inbound video/audio call histories
